### 2026-10-12 309 DECISION: first session - investigation only; the check will be a stdlib module (tools/right_place.py, to be added to Touches) because the owner's Mac has no PIL, and the decisive offline signal for the Brighton case is the book's own list-of-figures section (county-organized), not a gazetteer
Task 309 (carved from 307) investigated. Facts established by running the real data (.venv/bin/python): (1) the matcher's namesake trap for Allcroft fig 217 is an exact-name tie ("Devil's Dyke Camp" -> "devil dyke" == Q3307343's name, score 1.0, runner_up 0.4) with an EMPTY place dict - Brighton is a city, and place_of() only extracts county/state words, so no contradiction check can fire inside books_match; the evidence contract is satisfied by the namesake, so 309's check is new logic. (2) The right site for the picture EXISTS in the catalog: devil-s-dyke-hillfort-q17674160 (Q17674160, West Sussex/Poynings). (3) data/books/lists/earthworkenglan01allcgoog.json's figures list is organized by county: fig 212 states Sussex, figs 213-223 (incl. 217) are county-free, fig 224 states Somerset - the section county of fig 217 is sussex; this is the picture's own metadata and the offline resolution that flags "near Brighton" vs Cambridgeshire. (4) Recorded evidence conflicts in review candidates are NOISY: true namesakes (bethlehem NL vs Holy Land x17, alauna->Ardoch 174km, cenabum->New Orleans, york-castle->Broome County NY) sit next to garbage resolutions (stonehenge "Larned" 7252km - an author name; fletio "Wit" the cartographer; glevum "Bristol" resolving to a US Bristol 5282km; durocortorum "Reims" 59km just over the 50km tolerance) - H3 (conflict>50km) needs a plausibility filter on named_place, decided by eyeballing the full flag list. (5) sites.json ids differ from catalog Q-ids for the SAME place (marietta, forthill, newark vs their Q-id catalog rows, ~150m apart) - any tied-away check needs the 50km distance guard or 12 candidates false-flag. (6) Sites with no catalog admin county (leeds-castle, fairlawne, chevening, chiswick-house) must never be flagged on a county word (unknown site county = no contradiction); my first throwaway script had exactly this bug. (7) tools/fit_queue.py must stay stdlib-only (owner's Mac, no PIL; even this VM's system python3 lacks PIL) so pipeline/books_match CANNOT be imported - a stdlib copy of its core goes in a new tools/right_place.py (added to Touches), guarded by a venv-only drift test against the real matcher. (8) test_fit_queue_synthetic's tree has only the four inputs - the check must be a no-op when the extra stores are absent (keep that test passing unmodified); test_fit_queue_real derives the entry set from the four inputs alone and WILL need updating with the same check. Design draft and the exact next steps (incl. the section-walk re-verification: the throwaway walk mis-keyed entries and returned somerset for fig 217) are in the task hand-over.

### 2026-10-12 309 DECISION: iteration 93 - the section-county walk is abandoned as the flag; the verified signal is town-word resolution through the catalog's admin values (non-circular, per-entry), with H1 extended to Scottish county words
Session 2, investigation only (no code, no repo changes; scratch in /tmp: walk_check2b.py, town_check2.py). Findings: (1) The Allcroft list of 203 figures is NOT county-sectioned as a whole (118 entries carry explicit county words, scattered); session 1's "section county" premise was wrong for the book even though the Brighton run (figs 212-223, sussex) does exist. (2) Corrected walk (carry last single-county marker; reset on two-county entries; county-free keeps) verified: 213-223=sussex, 224=somerset. Session 1's two script bugs: carry reset on county-free entries; vote window never broke at the section end. (3) CONFIRMATION BY VOTING THE MATCHER'S OWN MATCHES FAILS: Brighton section votes 6 sussex vs 5 other = 54% (< 2/3) because the matcher's own false matches (217/218/220/221) are the dissenters - circular. Walk dropped from the flag. (4) VERIFIED WINNING SIGNAL: word -> set(classic counties of catalog sites carrying that word in an admin value), <=4 counties kept (2647->2626 words); town words = title comma parts after the name part + row.place, minus GENERIC/county words/TOWN_STOP {bury,down,ross,lodge,maiden,cotton,more,shire}, attributions {...}/(after ...) stripped; flag when site county known, no explicit county word in the picture, and site county not in the resolved set. Allcroft-wide: 19 flags, eyeballed = ~14 true namesakes (incl. fig 217 Brighton->cambridgeshire = the case; 218, 221, 131, 134, 156, 191, 24, 25, 5, 99) vs fixable false positives (72 'bury', 87 'cotton', 119 'clifford', 151 'lodge/maiden' -> the latter two fixed by "H2 only when no explicit county word is present"). Must-not-flag verified: Maumbury fig 201 ('dorchester' -> {dorset, oxfordshire} contains site's dorset) and sites with unknown county. (5) 'brighton' -> {'sussex'} only ('Brighton and Hove' county value; the Flintshire New Brighton site has no parish field). 'bath' needs 'Bath and North East Somerset' -> 'somerset' added to the classic table (fig 89). (6) H1 needs UK_COUNTIES_EXT += {perthshire, peeblesshire, berwickshire, somersetshire, devonshire, dorsetshire} (the matcher's UK_COUNTIES has no Scottish counties; ARDOCH row earthworkenglan01allcgoog_n0354_1 "ARDOCH, PERTHSHIRE." is paired with 4 built sites: coria-q3819299, vindomora-q7932358, braughing-roman-town-q4958235, banovallum-q96359174). (7) Wiring facts: devil-s-dyke-hillfort-q17674160 is NOT built (move destination = new review item, not queue); data/review/devil-s-dyke-q3307343.earthworkenglan01allcgoog_n0599_1.json already holds both n0686_1 (Brighton) and n0599_1 (Aysgarth) as candidates -> devil-s-dyke just loses both from the queue; fit/review.py is stdlib-only, importable by tools/fit_queue.py; US admin = state only (no town signal; H1 states cover it; the Ohio tied-away trio needs the 50km guard only for H3). (8) The 111 distinct catalog county values were enumerated (regeneration command in the task hand-over) - the CLASSIC_UNITS table must cover all of them. Next session: add tools/right_place.py to Touches, write the module (verbatim matcher-core copy + classic table + load/picture_facts/check_pairing/find_right_site + CLI), run the CLI, eyeball, commit; then split 310 (wire + tests) / 311 (rebuild + docs + drift test) with Depends on: 309.
